text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: —I want to win.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: —I want to beat her.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: —To those girls whose backs I always chased.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
As rivals in the very same race!!
Side by side! Forging ahead! Surpassing everything in our path!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: I want to win!!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Yaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Haa... haa...
Haaah—...

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: (Joyful. Brutal. Fun. Exhausting. Burning. Freezing. And yet—)

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: —Tsurumaru-san.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: So you're moving forward. Into rough, uncharted waters.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Daring to challenge the Umamusume of this generation.
Even when faced with a sheer precipice that may prove insurmountable.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Still, no future exists
that "cannot be surpassed."

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
That's why you're taking on the challenge too, right, King-chan?
Believing in the potential of your own future.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: You too, Grass-chan.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: ...You're quite well-informed.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: It is only the pinnacle that lies beyond that truly deserves the title of 'The Strongest.'

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: That is true, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: I know, right?!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
...Heh.
Heheh... ahaha.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Sigh, I'll take my leave now.
I want to go declare war on the other one, too.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
! I'm coming to that too!
It's for Spe-chan, right!?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Then let's all—huh?
Where's Spe-chan...?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
! Good job today, Spe-chan.
I came to cheer for you—

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: ...Ms., Suzuka.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I'm no good, I'm terrible...
I'm not the kind of Umamusume who deserves to be cheered on...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"...Whenever I look at her,
everything before my eyes turns bright red."

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"Why did you catch up to me?"
"No, don't leave me behind," she said.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: ...I catch myself thinking, 'No, I don't want to.'

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I know how hard she's worked, too!
And yet, I hate it! I don't want to give it up!
I don't want to be passed! —I don't want to lose!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: I don't want to lose to her............!!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
...Yes.
Is that so?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
...Huh, not here either.
Where could Spe-chan have gone?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Maybe I can see them after the concert.
Or tomorrow at school—
—A few days later.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Spe-chan is taking a break for a while?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Yes, she went back to her family home starting today.
She told us not to worry, she'll be back for summer camp.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Could you pass the word to the other girls too?
You have lots of friends, Spe-chan.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
U-Understood!
Leave it to me!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: I see, so until the summer training camp, Spe-chan and I...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
You're Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi, right?
Spe-chan's friend.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Could you tell me your schedule moving forward, if you don't mind?
I'd like to let Spe-chan know.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"What is won on the track
can only ever be repaid on the track."

The day after the Takarazuka Kinen.
Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi walked into the Trainer's office,
deep in thought.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Trainer. Our next goal is... the Tenno Sho (Autumn), right?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
The distance aptitude is a perfect match, too.
And besides...
choice_data_list: I think your rival will be running in that race too.
I think your rival will be running, too.

text_block_list.text:
The Tenno Sho (Autumn) is a 2000m GⅠ held in Tokyo.
It's a middle-distance race that her rivals also excel at.
choice_data_list: Should we run in the Kyoto Daishoten first for that?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
"The 'Kyoto Daishoten'... Ah!
That's the prep race for the 'Tenno Sho (Autumn)'!"

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Got it!
I'll go pass along the message!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: —Into my rival!
